excluded.handback_oracle_capability: An evaluation definition, not a property of the system or the world: it does not change any simulated run, only which runs form the AC-03 strata, AC-07 and AC-08. It is fixed (reference.yaml) precisely so that design variants (e.g. ACC authority) keep comparable populations, and its immaturity is carried by its requirement status (provisional).
excluded.ideal_reference_braking_level: Also an evaluation definition (scope of AC-01/AC-03). Its immaturity is carried by its requirement status; the reference-independent AC-09/AC-10 do not depend on it.
excluded.dt_and_horizon: Numerical settings, covered by the convergence tests (dt/2) and the explicit horizon_unresolved terminal state rather than by a design-of-experiments.
excluded.exposure_correlations: The exposure model is factorized; correlations are not parameterised and cannot be varied until a joint model exists (docs/limitations.md).
excluded.reaction_time_speed_dependence: Not parameterised in the driver model (assumed independent of speed).
